title: awesome
text: awesome. great filters - i purchased 2 machines a few months  and just now changed the filters and cleaned them up inside  i could NOT believe what was in the machine  i have 2 cats and there was clumps of hair, dead bugs, dust galore, cuz they are next to the cat boxes .... it was pretty gross  but i was happy that the filters and the other filters in the machine caught it all !!!  will continue to buy these and keep the air clean

features: TRAPS AND NEUTRALIZES TOBACCO ODORS: Keep your home fresh and clean by replacing your Hamilton Beach TrueAir filters. These carbon filters were specially formulated to neutralize pet odors.
